# Broken Decision

This body is deliberately invalid for the dec schema (no Context and Problem
Statement, no Decision Outcome, no Roles and Responsibilities, no Source), so
every parse channel fails on it. Its raw text still carries a live-looking
reference -- REQ c009c009-c009-4c09-8c09-c009c009c009: Wide Requirement One --
that a scan which failed to skip this document would turn into an edge (the
skip-broken negative pin).
